title: For L¹-a.e. t the slice M ∩ f⁻¹{t} is H^m-null-measurable
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let M ⊆ ℝ^P be H^{m+1}-null-measurable and let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be Borel measurable. Write Hᵏ := μHE[k] (Euclidean Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P) and L¹ for Lebesgue measure on ℝ. Assume the null-transfer property for (M, f): for every predicate p on ℝ^P that holds for H^{m+1}-a.e. x ∈ M (∀ᵐ x ∂(H^{m+1} restricted to M), p x), for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ the predicate p holds for H^m-a.e. x ∈ M ∩ f⁻¹{t} (∀ᵐ x ∂(H^m restricted to M ∩ f⁻¹{t}), p x). Then for L¹-a.e. t ∈ ℝ the set M ∩ f⁻¹{t} is H^m-null-measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)) → Measurable f → (∀ p : Eucl P → Prop, (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), p x) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t})), p x) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), NullMeasurableSet (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))
